name: Botifarra
summary: Catalan 4-player partnership point-trick game with strict forced-play rules enabling deduction, related to Manilla.
rules_text: 48-card Spanish deck. Cards rank 9(highest, Manilla/5pts), Ace(4), King/12(3), Horse/11(2), Jack/10(1), 8,7,6,5,4,3,2. Each trick is 1 point. 72 points per hand. Team scoring excess over 36. Game to 101. Deal all cards 4 at a time anti-clockwise. Dealer chooses trump suit, no-trump (Botifarra), or passes to partner who must choose. Defenders may double (Contrar), then declarers may redouble, then defenders may re-re-double, in anti-clockwise order. Botifarra doubles hand score. Lead any card. Must follow suit if able. If partner is not winning, must beat every card in trick if possible, including trumping/overtrumping. If not beating: if partner winning must play a counting card (9,A,K,H,J) or your lowest of the suit played; if opponents winning must play your lowest of suit played. Second player exception may play counting card when cannot follow.
